beats.say: JADE has scored her first US Spotify chart entry, two and a half years after release.
Billboard reports her debut solo single Angel of My Dreams debuted on Wednesday 21 October at number 197.
So how did a song with just 18,000 streams on show day suddenly explode?
Billboard says the track soundtracked Kylie Jenner walking the catwalk in a 50 million dollar Fantasy Bra.
After Kylie hit the runway on 18 October, daily streams ballooned by 1,434 per cent to over 284,000.
Did you spot this track during the show?

meta.title: JADE hits US charts years after debut 🎶
meta.alt_title: How Kylie Jenner revived JADE's solo single ✨
meta.summary: JADE has debuted on the Spotify US Daily Top Songs chart at number 197 with Angel of My Dreams after Kylie Jenner soundtracked her runway walk to the track. Streams skyrocketed over 1,400 per cent following the catwalk appearance.
meta.comment: Did you spot Angel of My Dreams during the show?
sources: Billboard, Will Kylie Jenner’s Victoria’s Secret Moment Finally Turn JADE’s ‘Angel of My Dreams’ Into a Viral Hit?
facts: On Wednesday (Oct. 21), Angel debuted on the Spotify US Daily Top Songs USA chart at No. 197, two and a half years post-release.
Brit Award-winning pop sensation JADE did not take the stage, but her beloved debut solo single, Angel of My Dreams soundtracked Kylie Jenners sultry, $50 million Fantasy Bra-sporting catwalk.
On the day of the show, Angel scored just 18,000 official streams.
After Kylie hit the runway (Oct. 18), Angel ballooned by a jaw-dropping 1,434% to over 284,000 official streams.

pt.title: JADE entra nas paradas dos EUA anos depois 🎶

hi.title: JADE सालों बाद यूएस चार्ट्स में शामिल 🎶
hi.summary: काइली जेनर द्वारा अपने रैंप वॉक में गाना इस्तेमाल करने के बाद JADE का गाना Angel of My Dreams स्पॉटिफाई यूएस डेली टॉप सॉन्ग्स चार्ट पर 197 नंबर पर debut कर गया है। कैटवॉक के बाद स्ट्रीम्स में 1400 प्रतिशत से ज्यादा की बढ़ोतरी हुई।
